# debian/sway/under_test.txt - programs being tried under sway, not
# installed by the build. Try one with: sudo apt install <PACKAGE>
# When it works well: move it to tested.txt (or packages.txt). When it
# does not: move it to discarded.txt with the reason.
#
# Web browsers
firefox-esr             # Firefox web browser (heavy for the tablet)
epiphany-browser        # GNOME Web browser
fonts-liberation2       # fonts for web pages
librsvg2-common         # SVG icons in GTK programs
# Databases
sqlitebrowser           # SQLite databases, graphical
# Touch
wvkbd                   # on-screen keyboard (not set up yet)
lisgd                   # touch gestures from the screen edges (not set up yet)
# Screenshots and clipboard
grim                    # screenshot
slurp                   # select a screen area (for grim)
wl-clipboard            # clipboard from the command line (wl-copy, wl-paste)
# GPU check and benchmark
mesa-utils              # GPU information (eglinfo)
glmark2-es2-wayland     # GPU benchmark
# Input debugging
libinput-tools          # show input events (libinput debug-events)
